entities.name: White Woods
entities.description: A vast mysterious forest in Casindral in southern Corondor on Dominaria, refuge of the Quirion Elves.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Dominarian region in which Casindral lies.

entities.name: Quirion Elves
entities.description: Elves who migrated into the White Woods and became a society of warrior-mages.

entities.name: Eskil the White
entities.description: Old blind planeswalker who lived in the White Woods and trained Mangara.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: Trained by Eskil in the White Woods; later took the Quirion to the Mirage War.

entities.name: Estolade
entities.description: River running through the White Woods.

entities.name: Teferi's Isle
entities.description: Island whose disappearance Mangara went to Jamuraa to investigate.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: War in which Mangara brought the Quirion.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Era after which the Quirion migrated into the woods.

events.summary: The Quirion elves migrate into the White Woods' inner regions after the Ice Age and defend their independence.
events.quote: The Quirion elves migrated into the White Woods' dense inner regions after the Ice Age

events.summary: Mangara is trained in the White Woods by Eskil and gains the Quirion's loyalty.
events.quote: Mangara was trained in the White Woods by old blind Eskil

events.summary: More than a century later Mangara brings the Quirion to the Mirage War.
events.quote: he brought them with him to take part in the Mirage War
